title: Restaurants & Ordering
description: Ordering, allergies and dietary restrictions. The allergy phrases are the ones worth being able to say without hesitating.

phrases.registerNotes: Said before every meal, alone or in company. Not saying it is the noticeable thing, not saying it.
phrases.animeNote: Anime gets this one right — it's used exactly as often in real life.

phrases.japanese: メニューをお願いします
phrases.registerNotes: 英語のメニューはありますか asks for an English one.
phrases.audioHint: メニューをおねがいします

phrases.japanese: アレルギーがあります

furigana.b: アレルギーがあります

phrases.registerNotes: Lead with this, then name the item. Worth having written on your phone in Japanese as well as spoken.
phrases.audioHint: アレルギーがあります

phrases.registerNotes: 〜が食べられません is the pattern — swap the food. Stronger and clearer than saying you don't like it.
phrases.audioHint: たまごがたべられません
